label: Belvedere, Vatican
summary: Papal villa of Innocent VIII on the Vatican hill, joined to the palace by Bramante's courtyard; named in the inventory (pl-rome) as Leonardo's lodging in Rome.

claims.statement: Modern coordinates of the site as given by a web gazetteer or encyclopedia page found by search. Point is the courtyard; Innocent VIII's villa where Leonardo lodged is at its north end.

sources.cite: Cortile del Belvedere, English Wikipedia infobox as reported in search results (background only).

claims.statement: Records of works carried out at the Belvedere for Leonardo's lodging in late 1513 are cited in the literature (not checked here).
